name: The Heroic Age: An Avengers Reading List
description: The Heroic Age relaunches the Avengers, and Steve Rogers, Iron Man, Thor and Luke Cage carry them into Fear Itself. Avengers Prime is the prologue, then Brian Michael Bendis's Avengers and New Avengers alternate volume by volume with Secret Avengers, launched by Ed Brubaker, to the edge of Avengers vs X-Men. An issue shared at a volume boundary is read once, in the earlier volume.
sourceOrigin: Compiled for this project from Comic Book Herald's guide
